p: prophets with the sword: That is, of Baal.
So let the gods do to: Though the wicked rage against God's children, yet he holds them back so they cannot execute their malice.
take away my life: It is so hard to control our impatience in affliction, that the saints could not overcome the same.
the journey is too great for: He declares that unless God had nourished him miraculously it would have been impossible for him to have gone on this journey.
been very jealous for the LORD: He complains that the more zealous he was to maintain God's glory, the more cruelly he was persecuted.
not in the wind: For the nature of man is not able to come near God, if he appeared in his strength and full majesty, and therefore he mercifully submits himself to our limitations.
because the children of Israel have: So should not depend on the multitude in maintaining God's glory, but because our duty requires us to do it.
all the knees which have not: He declares that wicked deceivers and idolaters are not his.
Let me: Though this natural affection is not to be contemned, yet it should not move us when God calls us to serve him.
instruments of the oxen: He would not stay till wood was brought, so great was his desire to follow his calling.
